sets.title: Form and Identify
sets.description: Choose the correct present passive participle
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите правильное страдательное причастие настоящего времени

items.promptEnglish: to solve → we solve → being solved

items.prompt: Задача, _____ нами сейчас, очень сложная. (The problem being solved by us now is very difficult.)
items.promptEnglish: The problem being solved by us now is very difficult.
items.explanation: Present passive feminine: решаемая (agrees with задача).

items.promptEnglish: to value → we value → valued/being valued

items.prompt: Это мой _____ ресторан. (This is my favorite restaurant.)
items.explanation: Любимый is a present passive participle used as an adjective meaning 'favorite/beloved.'

items.promptEnglish: to control → we control → controllable/being controlled

minimalPairs.context: _____ всеми актёр (who is loved by all - passive)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: An actor loved by all (receives the action)
minimalPairs.explanation: Passive: the actor receives love. Любимый = being loved/beloved.

minimalPairs.context: _____ свою работу актёр (who loves his work - active)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: An actor who loves his work (does the action)
minimalPairs.explanation: Active: the actor does the loving. Любящий = who loves.

minimalPairs.context: _____ нами результат (a result we can see)
minimalPairs.explanation: Passive: the result is being seen. Видимый = visible/being seen.

minimalPairs.context: _____ опасность водитель (a driver who sees danger)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: A driver who sees the danger
minimalPairs.explanation: Active: the driver does the seeing. Видящий = who sees.

sets.title: Sort and Fill
sets.description: Sort by conjugation group and fill in participle forms
sets.descriptionRussian: Распределите по спряжению и заполните формы причастий

categorySorting.instruction: Sort these present passive participles by conjugation group

blanks: Вопрос, _____ на собрании, касается всех. (The question being discussed at the meeting concerns everyone.)
Это _____ всеми песня. (This is a song loved by everyone.)
Шум за стеной едва _____. (The noise behind the wall is barely audible.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Present passive participle forms and agreement
hints: The question is being discussed (passive, ongoing, masc nom). From обсуждать (1st conj): обсуждаем + -ый.
The song is loved (passive, ongoing, fem nom). From любить (2nd conj): любим + -ая.
The noise is barely audible (short form, masc). From слышать (2nd conj): short form of слышимый.
Dear guests (formal address, nom pl). From уважать (1st conj): уважаем + -ые.
explanations: Обсуждаемый: present passive (1st conj), masc nom agreeing with вопрос. The question receives the action of discussion.
Любимая: present passive (2nd conj), fem nom agreeing with песня. The song receives the action of being loved.
Слышим: short form of слышимый (masc), used predicatively. The noise 'is audible' (barely heard).
Уважаемые: present passive (1st conj), nom pl. Standard formal address, from уважать → уважаемый → уважаемые.

errorCorrection.hint: The problem receives the action (is being solved), so use passive, not active.
errorCorrection.explanation: Решающая is active (who solves). The problem is being solved (passive): решаемая.

errorCorrection.hint: The actor is loved by all (receives love), not 'who loves all.'
errorCorrection.explanation: Любящий is active (who loves). The actor is loved (passive): любимый.

errorCorrection.hint: Коллеги is plural, so the participle must agree: уважаемые.
errorCorrection.explanation: Agreement error: коллеги (plural) requires уважаемые (plural), not уважаемая (feminine singular).

sets.title: Translate and Choose
sets.description: Translate sentences with present passive participles
sets.descriptionRussian: Переведите предложения со страдательными причастиями настоящего времени

items.prompt: Which verb CANNOT form a present passive participle?
items.promptEnglish: Present passive participles need transitive imperfective verbs.
items.hint: Intransitive verbs cannot form passive participles.
items.explanation: Сидеть is intransitive (no direct object), so it cannot form a passive participle.

items.prompt: Form the present passive participle: изучать (to study) → ?
items.explanation: Изучать (transitive impf) → изучаемый (being studied). -ющий is active present; -енный is past passive.

translation.explanation: Любить → любимый (present passive, 2nd conj). Agrees with песня (fem) = любимая; agent in instrumental = всеми.

translation.prompt: the subject studied by the students
translation.explanation: Изучать → изучаемый (being studied). Agent in instrumental: студентами.
Рекомендовать → рекомендуемый. Fem = рекомендуемая; agent in instrumental: врачами.

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: Mixed exercises covering all aspects of present passive participles
sets.descriptionRussian: Разнообразные задания по страдательным причастиям настоящего времени

items.promptEnglish: to keep/store → we keep → being kept

items.prompt: Эта книга _____ миллионами людей. (This book is read by millions of people.)
items.promptEnglish: This book is read by millions of people.
items.explanation: Present passive feminine: читаемая (agrees with книга). The book receives the action of reading.

items.prompt: Present passive participles are most common in:
items.promptEnglish: Where are present passive participles used most?
items.hint: These participles are bookish and formal.
items.explanation: Present passive participles are the rarest type and mainly used in formal writing, academic texts, and set phrases.

items.prompt: _____ коллектором данные были утеряны. (The data being collected was lost.)
items.promptEnglish: The data being collected was lost.
items.explanation: Present passive plural: собираемые (agrees with данные). The data receives the action of collection.

items.prompt: Это _____ концерт. (This is an unforgettable concert.)
items.explanation: Незабываемый: не- + забываемый. An adjective derived from a present passive participle.
